meta.title: SLATE pet care research: dry dog and cat foods at the grocers, a shelf's makers first
meta.supplements: research-pet-care.json (feeding.products shape: market, type, brand, product, kg, price, currency, retailer, url, status).
meta.method: Read mechanically on 2026-10-04 from the chains' own catalogue feeds, as research-groceries3.json: the Wynshop storefront search for Price Rite (store 301), The Fresh Grocer (197), Smart & Final (371) and SuperValu (5550); Giant Tiger's Shopify pet food collection, the listing tagged for Ontario; Chedraui's VTEX catalogue search. Dry dog and cat food by the bag only, as the pet catalog keeps it (a day's ration is a dry food's grams): no cans, pouches, treats or chews, and a bag of at least 300 grams. Up to six makers a species a chain, one of each, the cheapest a kilogram first, a food whose name states no maker left out. Each at its regular shelf price, as research-groceries3.json. Britain's grocers refuse automated reads and Save-On-Foods' feed answered a bot check, so no British or British Columbian grocer is here.
